evidence_items.claim: Lloyds Banking Group is a FINOS Gold member, joined March 2023
evidence_items.excerpt: FINOS announced the addition of Lloyds Banking Group as a new Gold member. Allan Woodcock, Engineering Services Director: 'Partnering with FINOS will empower our talented engineers to give back to the Open Source Community.'
evidence_items.caveats: FINOS Gold membership indicates ecosystem commitment but does not confirm CDM-specific engagement.

evidence_items.claim: Lloyds has an active Open Source Program Office (OSPO) with dedicated leadership
evidence_items.excerpt: Red Hat collaborates with Lloyds Banking Group's Open Source Program Office (OSPO) to support InnerSource implementation. Pooi Ling Cheong, OSPO Lead.
evidence_items.caveats: OSPO indicates open source maturity but focus is on InnerSource practices, not derivatives/CDM.

evidence_items.claim: Lloyds participated in FCA/BOE Digital Regulatory Reporting pilot phases 1 and 2 (2018-2019)
evidence_items.excerpt: Two phases of the DRR pilot have been completed, involving collaboration between the FCA, BOE and seven banks: Barclays, Credit Suisse, HSBC, Lloyds, Nationwide, Natwest and Santander.
evidence_items.caveats: Historical pilot (2018-2019). No evidence of post-pilot DRR production adoption.

evidence_items.claim: Lloyds hosted FINOS 'Open Source Edinburgh' event at their offices (October 2023)
evidence_items.excerpt: FINOS and Scott Logic held 'Open Source Edinburgh' at Lloyds Banking Group offices as part of Scottish Fintech Festival. Attendees learned about Lloyds' OSPO journey.
evidence_items.caveats: Event hosting shows FINOS engagement but not CDM-specific activity.
